annotations.title: Attach a file to a document

description: Attaches one file to a document already on HTMLRadar, for readers of its links to download. The file types are the website's (PDF, Office documents, images, CSV, text, Markdown, ZIP) and a document holds up to 20 files. The file travels as base64 in `content_base64`, because a tool argument is JSON, so it can be at most 5.0 MB, the same limit as publishing a page this way; a larger file (the website takes 25 MB) is added on the website. Readers see the file from the next time they load the page. There is no file-path argument: a file on disk reaches this tool only as content the caller has already read.

document_id.description: The document — the document id from list_documents or list_shares.

filename.description: The file name with its extension, e.g. "pricing.pdf". The extension decides the type.
